def count_distinct_concatenations(s, t):
    n, m = len(s), len(t)
    distinct_concatenations = set()
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            prefix_s = s[:i]
            prefix_t = t[:j]
            distinct_concatenations.add(prefix_s + prefix_t)
    
    return len(distinct_concatenations)

print(count_distinct_concatenations(s, t))
